pathway.title: Worship electric in 14 weeks
pathway.subtitle: Learning pathway
pathway.intro: Rhythm electric that builds the song and plays one clean lead line at the peak of a hymn. Five sessions a week, thirty minutes each. Every day is one page: press start, play, log it.

phases.name: Phase 1
phases.title: Clean hands
phases.outcome: A lead line that hits only the note.
phases.gate: Muting test 5/5 clean on the drive patch. Three clean picking passes at 60 BPM, four notes per click. One recording exists.

days.title: The muting test
days.summary: Find out what rings. Palm on the bass strings, index flat across the trebles. Then the picking drill on the high e.

days.title: Same drill, listen harder
days.summary: Identical to day 1. The change is in the ears: stop the note with the palm, hear the silence.

days.title: Picking moves to the B string
days.summary: Muting as before. The picking drill moves one string down. Thicker string, same rule: even volume or stay at the tempo.

days.title: Record it
days.summary: Picking on the G string. Then the phone goes on the floor and the song block gets recorded. Listen once.

days.title: Gate check
days.summary: Run the gate. Five clean muting tests in a row, three clean picking passes. Pass or repeat the week; both are fine.

phases.name: Phase 2
phases.title: Build energy
phases.outcome: Chorus on triads up the neck, verse quiet.
phases.gate: Verse on open chords, chorus on triads up the neck, same song. Same eight bars at 30, 60 and 100, recorded.

phases.name: Phase 3
phases.title: Lead voice
phases.outcome: One clean fill with one in-tune bend at the peak.
phases.gate: Pentatonic box 1 in G, E, C, F naming the notes. Whole-step bend matches the fretted target 10 of 10.

phases.name: Phase 4
phases.title: Texture
phases.outcome: A swell under a quiet moment. Transpose on the spot.
phases.gate: Swell into a held note, attack gone. Four bars with dotted-eighth delay, half the notes. Transpose a hymn chart G to E.

phases.name: Phase 5
phases.title: Prove it
phases.outcome: One full hymn recorded standing, no chart.
